# Check if in json-parse map is not an array

## Pull Request by @DrEverr

Problem was with diplaying error message.
The error when trying to parse array as map was misleading.
This PR fix this.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved runtime validation for map fields so array values are rejected with a clearer "Expected map, got array" error, preventing incorrect parsing of map-typed inputs.
* **Tests**
  * Added tests verifying correct Map parsing and the new error scenario to ensure robust handling of invalid structures.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

A runtime validation was added in the map parser (packages/core/json-parser/descriptors.ts) to explicitly reject arrays by throwing "Expected map, got array" when the input is an array, in addition to the existing non-null object check. Two tests were added (packages/core/json-parser/index.test.ts) to verify successful Map<string, string> parsing and to assert the new error message when an array is provided. No public API or function signatures were changed.
